items.title: Near-optimal nonlinear erasure list-decodable codes via one-bit strong dispersers and an unbalanced two-source extractor
items.author: Avraham Ben-Aroya; Dean Doron; Amnon Ta-Shma
items.source_version: CCC2020 official complete27-page CC BY3.0 Unported publication. MainTheorem2/detailedTheorem46 with complete source-local Sections2–4 and Sections5.1/5.3 author proofs.
items.difficulty_reason: The construction conditions on a small row subtable to break circular dependence while preserving average min-entropy, separates constant bad-conditioning errors from small rowwise errors, and applies resilience to obtain a disperser whose seed/entropy-loss beats extractor limits before translating it to a nonlinear erasure code.
